title: CALM Extension Pack
description: Tooling catalog for one CALM extension pack (palette, icons, colors). Distinct from a CALM Standard: the Standard is a JSON Schema overlay on architecture documents; this pack file tells Studio, the VS Code plugin, Hub, and CLI how to present the types that Standard defines. Canonical files live at the monorepo root under extensions/. Hosts load these JSON files from the filesystem.

$id.description: Canonical URI of this pack file.

id.description: Short pack identifier used as the node-type prefix (except core, which is unprefixed).

label.description: Human-readable pack name in the palette.

version.description: Semantic version of this pack definition (independent of the Standard version).

standard.description: Reference to the CALM Standard (JSON Schema) that validates architectures using this pack.

relationships.description: Relationship types offered in the palette for this pack. Each entry maps to a CALM 1.2 relationship-type variant.

relationshipDefaults.description: Default relationship metadata when connecting nodes from this pack.

$id.description: Canonical $id of the CALM Standard JSON Schema. Hosts write this URI into architecture $schema (alongside the CALM 1.2 meta-schema) when the pack is first used — including when the URI is not yet published on calm.finos.org.

href.description: Filesystem path to the Standard JSON Schema, relative to this pack file. Core omits href and uses the published CALM 1.2 meta-schema.

$schema.description: Meta-schema of the Standard document itself. CALM Standards are JSON Schema 2020-12 documents.

calmVersion.description: CALM release the Standard composes with (for example 1.2).

status.description: published = Standard exists at $id (or is bundled). proposed = pack exists; Standard document is not yet published.

icon.description: Inline SVG (current packs) or an external SVG/PNG URI. Hosts that cannot render SVG from a URI fall back to a generic extension glyph.

oneOf.description: Inline SVG markup, typically 16x16 viewBox, stroke-based.

href.description: URI or pack-relative path to an icon file (svg, png).

typeId.description: CALM node-type. Colon-prefixed for extension packs (aws:lambda); unprefixed for core (actor).

isContainer.description: If true, the node renders as a container that accepts children.

rectangleLayout.description: If true, render as a bordered rectangle with icon beside the label (ArchiMate / core style).

defaultChildren.description: Child typeIds auto-placed when this container is dropped from the palette.

defaults.description: Values written onto a new node when placed from the palette.
